summary: Strengthen five BFF regression tests that passed without proving the guarantee they name. Test-only; no production file touched and no assertion weakened. Every strengthened assertion passes on current dev, so no production regression was found.

agora_tenantless_jwt_scope_denial.decision: The test used the permissive stub client, where a JWT bearer is parsed as a stub token with no roles and returns 403 AUTH_STUB_TOKEN_NO_ROLES before scope resolution, so it also passed without the fix. It now uses strict_client and asserts 403 with details.reason AGORA_SCOPE_TENANT_DENIED and details.precondition_failed agora_user_scope.
agora_tenantless_jwt_scope_denial.mutation_check: With agora/governance/router.py restored to its pre-a5e9396c7 content the test fails (500 != 403); restored afterwards.

research_notes_cutover.decision: CORRECTION of the BFF-RED-TESTS-COMPOSITION-20261007 entry read_surface_cutover_notes: it said the research owner answers experiment reads only and that the double should hide note methods. That was wrong. e194571a1 routed note list/get/create to the research owner and research/client.py ResearchServiceClient implements them, so hiding them made list_research_notes fall back to the in-memory _notes dict. The owner double now provides list_research_notes returning two notes and the test asserts those two ids, which the one-note in-memory store cannot produce.

registry_timeout.decision: The PATCH carried no token, so _headers raised TENANT_MISMATCH in about 2 ms before any socket I/O and urlopen(timeout=...) was never reached. The request now passes auth_token=_strict_token() like the sibling tests, and asserts a socket timeout reason with elapsed time between 0.8 s and 1.9 s for timeout=1, instead of pytest.raises(Exception).

persona_router_not_found_and_unavailable.decision: A removed route also returns 404, so the five not-found tests now assert the RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND error code. The owner-unavailable test clears PERSONA_URL, PANTHEON_PERSONA_URL and PANTHEON_PERSONA_API_URL with monkeypatch and asserts 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE with retryable true.

path_dedupe_ranking_formula_action.decision: RankingFormulaAction was retired by dab9aa6c2 and e87c896fd (git log -S). The 410 ACTION_RETIRED check now also asserts error.details.replacement is present.
